summary: Travel expense reimbursement allocated to wrong GL code; needs reclassification and PO linkage
description:
Issue summary:
An employee travel reimbursement (EXP-2026-117) for a conference stay was posted to GL 6100 (Marketing) instead of GL 6300 (Travel & Lodging). The payment has already been processed to the vendor (Rainway Hospitality) and shows on the March run. The original expense was tied to Purchase Order PO-5512 but the PO link is missing from the AP transaction, preventing straightforward GL reclassification via the AP UI.

Impact:
- Internal GLs are misstated for March close; trial balance shows an overstatement of marketing expense and understatement of travel.
- Finance close will need a manual journal if the AP record cannot be re-linked to PO-5512.
- Potential audit note if not corrected before month-end.

Environment:
- Prod accounting ledger (NetLedger), AP payment run March 2026, vendor: Rainway Hospitality.

Evidence:
- Expense ID: EXP-2026-117 (submitted by J. Nguyen)
- Invoice/Payment: INV-RH-3096, Paid on 2026-03-02, Amount: $1,432.50
- AP transaction shows GL 6100 and has no PO reference in AP_UI. PO-5512 exists in Procurement and references travel budget.

Desired outcome:
1) Re-link AP transaction to PO-5512 so standard reclassification flows can be used, OR
2) If re-linking is not possible, advise on required manual journal entries and who will post them, and confirm required approvals for audit trail.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open NetLedger AP transaction for INV-RH-3096. 2) Observe that the transaction line is assigned GL 6100 and has blank PO field. 3) Search procurement for PO-5512 and confirm that vendor and dates match the invoice. 4) Attempt to attach PO in AP_UI -> system returns 'PO not found' when using invoice reference.

Procurement record for PO-5512: PO-5512, vendor=Rainway Hospitality, purpose=Travel - KubeCon, budget_center=ENG-TRAVEL-6300.

investigation_notes:
- Root cause hypothesis: expense submitted under employee's card default category (Marketing) and invoice did not include PO reference, so AP auto-matching assigned default GL.
- Attempted automated fix failed because invoice date (2026-02-28) falls outside PO valid window in procurement system; procurement can extend PO validity or add exception.
- Temporary workaround: manual journal to move $1,432.50 from GL 6100 -> GL 6300 with supporting attachments.
- Long-term mitigation: update expense policy to require PO or reason field for travel reimbursements and add a validation in finance-automation to flag card transactions missing PO.
resolution_notes: Pending: Procurement to add matching note to PO-5512 and extend PO window OR AP to approve exception. Finance will post manual journal (debit 6300, credit 6100) on 2026-03-07 once procurement confirmation email is attached to ticket. After journal, Amira to confirm month-end balance and close ticket. Follow-up action: add validation to expense submission flow (owner: DevOps/Product) — tracked in backlog.
